claims: Michael B. Jordan won his first Oscar for Best Actor at the 98th Academy Awards on March 15, 2026.
Michael B. Jordan won the Oscar for his dual role as twins Smoke and Stack in the film Sinners.
The victory marked Michael B. Jordan's first Academy Award nomination.
The victory marked Michael B. Jordan's first Academy Award win.
Sinners was directed by Ryan Coogler.
Michael B. Jordan played identical twins Smoke and Stack in Sinners.
Michael B. Jordan thanked director Ryan Coogler during his acceptance speech.
Michael B. Jordan honored previous Black best actor winners including Denzel Washington and Will Smith during his acceptance speech
